title: Émigré Journals, Scouts, and Weekend Schools Abroad
grammar: Preverbs át- and össze- in preservation and community cohesion (átment, átörökít, összetart)
goal: I can analyze the institutional infrastructure of the Hungarian diaspora: scouting, weekend schools, and cultural houses.
I can use preverbs át- and össze- to describe cultural preservation, transmitting heritage, and communal cohesion.
I can discuss the nuances of bilingualism, generational language attrition, and dual cultural identity.
